resources.string: Use the system assistant button or gesture to open a new voice chat. On an unlocked phone, Minis requests microphone permission and sends the first completed utterance to your configured agent. Tap the microphone to take manual control. App-control permissions remain separate. Power-button behavior depends on your device settings.
Open Android Settings → Apps → Default apps → Digital assistant app and choose Minis.
Unlock your phone, then invoke Minis again.
